description: This file defines the DateFormatterInterface interface for date formatting in Drupal, including methods for formatting dates, intervals, and time differences.

classes.name: DateFormatterInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for date formatting in Drupal.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a date using a specified type or custom format string.

methods.name: formatInterval
methods.description: Formats a time interval with specified granularity.

methods.name: getSampleDateFormats
methods.description: Provides sample values for date formatting characters.

methods.name: formatTimeDiffUntil
methods.description: Formats the time difference from now until a given timestamp.

methods.name: formatTimeDiffSince
methods.description: Formats the time difference from a given timestamp to now.

methods.name: formatDiff
methods.description: Formats the difference between two timestamps.
